body:
Approved spec: .adlc/specs/SC-027-v24-ux-hierarchy-profile.md (v2.4, builds on SC-025). Presentation only: change src/savvycart/http.py rendering and src/savvycart/static/app.css; no engine, agent, guardrail, pantry, or fixture change. Every earlier test file is a frozen rail; new tests go only in tests/test_v24_page.py. Do not call Gemini in tests. Includes the uncommitted quantity-alignment change already in app.css. Cut-off 15:00 Colombo (F6); otherwise v2.3 (main) is deployed.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Profile card on every step and the offer page, reflecting budget, card count, and usual store. Verify: python -m pytest tests/test_v24_page.py::test_profile_card_reflects_current_selections_on_every_step -q
2. Short sample-data notice visible, full V2_BANNER expandable. Verify: python -m pytest tests/test_v24_page.py::test_sample_data_notice_stays_visible_with_details_expandable -q
3. Plan opens with a recommendation built from the engine plan; CP-SAT only inside details.how. Verify: python -m pytest tests/test_v24_page.py::test_plan_leads_with_a_recommendation_built_from_the_engine_plan -q
4. Pantry rows show a short timing label with the full history sentence expandable. Verify: python -m pytest tests/test_v24_page.py::test_pantry_rows_show_a_short_timing_label_and_expandable_history -q
5. Zero payout is amber; offer page returns to the plan. Verify: python -m pytest tests/test_v24_page.py::test_zero_payout_is_amber_and_offer_check_returns_to_the_plan -q
6. Agent tool calls behind 'How this was calculated: N agent tool calls'; answer and re-plan warning visible. Verify: python -m pytest tests/test_v24_page.py::test_agent_tool_calls_sit_behind_how_this_was_calculated -q
7. 44px touch targets (no sticky nav: spec revision 2). Verify: python -m pytest tests/test_v24_page.py::test_touch_targets_are_at_least_44px -q
8. No horizontal page scroll at 375px on Pantry, Plan, Why, and the offer page. Verify: Runtime.evaluate document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= 375 in the Cursor browser, screenshots in .adlc/evidence/SC-028-p6/
9. Every test passes; default plan unchanged (LKR 4,609, saving LKR 1,331). Verify: python -m pytest -q
10. README checker passes. Verify: python scripts/check_judge_readme.py
title: v2.4 build: recommendation-first hierarchy, mobile touch targets, Karuppan profile
